Per Intelligence Index Task

The GPT-6.1 Sol release offers 5 models, each with different intelligence, performance, and pricing characteristics. Below is a comparison of the key metrics across the 5 models.

For intelligence, the top model of GPT-6.1 Sol is GPT-6.1 Sol (max) at 52.
For output speed, the fastest model is GPT-6.1 Sol (max) at 66 t/s.
For latency, GPT-6.1 Sol (low) at 2.12s offers the lowest time to first answer token.
For pricing, GPT-6.1 Sol (low) at $0.13 offers the lowest cost per task. Prices vary up to 5.5x across models.
